text: vLLM's PagedAttention paper (SOSP 2023) measured KV cache memory waste from fragmentation and over reservation at 60-80% under naive contiguous allocation, block based paging with fixed size (16 token) blocks brought that under 4%, which is basically why almost every serious self hosted inference stack by 2026 runs some paged KV variant even when FlashAttention already covers the compute side.
